rag_sources.title: Trichomoniasis: Background, Pathophysiology, Etiology
rag_sources.excerpt: Trichomoniasis is thought to be widely underdiagnosed owing to various factors, including a lack of routine testing, the low sensitivity of a commonly used diagnostic technique (wet mount microscopy), and nonspecific symptomatology. Self-diagnosis and self-treatment or diagnosis by practitioners without adequate laboratory testing may also contribute to misdiagnosis.
